note: 原文逐字取自 docs/audit/dos-ecl-text-inventory.json；原版 block 不修改。專有名詞依 docs/reference/manual/glossary.md，說明書沒有的另記在該檔的「遊戲內文字新增譯名」一節。

entries.note: 神殿的問句，原版開頭多一個空格。

entries.source: 'BEHIND THESE DOORS ARE THE SPECIAL TRAINING SCHOOLS  WHERE ADVENTURERS INCREASE THEIR SKILLS. LET US NOW GO TO THE CITY'S MOST IMPORTANT BUILDING.'
entries.text: 「這幾道門後面是各種訓練所，冒險者在裡面精進本事。接下來去看看城裡最重要的建築。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第五頁。訓練所沿用說明書 p.9 的用詞。

entries.source: 'BEYOND THIS GATE ARE THE MONSTER-RIDDEN AREAS OF THE OLD CITY WE ARE SLOWLY PREPARING FOR SETTLEMENT.  THE COUNCIL OFFERS A GENEROUS REWARD TO THOSE WHO CLEAR AREAS OF MONSTERS.
entries.text: 「這道門外就是舊城區，那裡滿是怪物，我們正一步步整頓、準備讓人遷入。清掉一區怪物的人，市議會會給一筆優厚的報酬。
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第七頁。原版這一句沒有結尾引號，照原樣不補。

entries.source: 'BY ORDER OF THE CITY COUNCIL,' THE HARBOR MASTER SAYS, 'THE ONLY BOAT OUT IS GOING TO SOKAL KEEP.  YOU CAN CATCH IT AT THE END OF THE PIER.'
entries.text: 港務長說：「市議會有令，現在唯一出港的船是開往索卡爾城堡的。到碼頭盡頭就能搭上。」

entries.source: 'CATCH THE BOAT AT THE END OF THE PIER.'
'DUE TO YOUR VICIOUS ATTACK ON THOSE WHO PROTECT US, WE REFUSE YOU ALL SERVICE.'
entries.text: 「你們竟然攻擊保護我們的人，這裡不再為你們提供任何服務。」

entries.source: 'GREETINGS, COURAGEOUS ONES, I AM ROLF, APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL TO INTRODUCE NEWCOMERS TO THE FAIR CITY OF PHLAN. IF YOU WILL ACCOMPANY ME, I WILL START THE TOUR.'
entries.text: 「勇敢的朋友們，你們好。我是羅夫，市議會派我為新來的人介紹美麗的菲蘭城。願意跟我走一趟的話，導覽這就開始。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第一頁。Phlan 依 glossary 定案作菲蘭；Rolf 說明書未收，見 glossary 的「遊戲內文字新增譯名」。

entries.source: 'HE IS BOUND TO RECOVER THE TEMPLE WHICH HAS BEEN DESECRATED TO BANE.  GO WITH HIM ACROSS THE RIVER AND HELP HIM TO CLEANSE THE TEMPLE.  IN PAYMENT, YOU MAY KEEP THE HIDDEN TREASURES.'
entries.text: 「他發願要奪回那座被獻給邪惡神的神殿。跟他過河去，幫他把神殿清乾淨。作為報酬，藏在裡面的財寶歸你們。」
entries.note: 巴西歐主教的委託；Bane 依 glossary 作邪惡（神）。

entries.source: 'IT WILL COST YOU 1 PLATINUM PIECE TO REST HERE.  DO YOU WANT TO STAY?'
entries.text: 「在這裡休息要一枚白金幣。你們要住下嗎？」

entries.source: 'ON YOUR RIGHT IS ONE OF THE ENTRANCE'S TO SUNE'S TEMPLE. AS WITH ALL PHLAN'S TEMPLES, VARIOUS CLERICAL SERVICES ARE OFFERED INSIDE.  ON YOUR LEFT IS AN ENTRANCE TO THE CITY PARK.'
entries.text: 「右手邊是蘇妮神殿的入口之一。和菲蘭城其他神殿一樣，裡面提供各種神職服務。左手邊則是通往市立公園的入口。」

entries.source: 'OUR TOUR IS ENDED. AGAIN, LET ME URGE YOU TO APPLY TO THE CITY CLERK FOR A COMMISSION.  GOOD-BYE AND GOOD FORTUNE.' (YOU ARE ON YOUR OWN NOW)
entries.text: 「導覽到此結束。再提醒一次，記得去找書記官接委託。再會，祝你們好運。」（接下來就靠你們自己了）
entries.note: Rolf 導覽最後一頁。括號內是原版給玩家的旁白，不是羅夫的話。

entries.source: 'THE GAME WORKS LIKE THIS.  WE SPIN THIS TOP. IF THE GREEN SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK.  IF A BLUE SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET YOUR MONEY BACK.  IF A RED SIDE COMES UP, YOU LOSE.'
entries.text: 「規則是這樣：我們轉這個陀螺。轉到綠面，你們拿回兩倍的錢；轉到藍面，錢原數奉還；轉到紅面，你們就輸了。」

entries.source: 'WE ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THESE WALLS. INSIDE, THE CITY CLERK AWARDS THE COUNCIL'S COMMISSIONS.  COMMISSIONS ARE THE QUICKEST WAY TO FAME AND FORTUNE.'
entries.text: 「我們就在市政廳外面。公告都貼在這幾面牆上。裡頭的書記官負責發放市議會的委託。想快點成名發財，接委託是最快的路。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第四頁。commission 沿用專案既有的「委託」。
巴西歐主教的委託；Dirten 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'YOU NOW FACE AN ENTRANCE TO THE TEMPLE OF TYR.  THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES IN PHLAN: TYR'S, SUNE'S, AND TEMPUS. TYR'S IS THE LARGEST AND HOUSES BISHOP BRACCIO. IF YOU WILL TURN AROUND NOW, '
entries.text: 「你們面前是提爾神殿的入口。菲蘭城裡有三座神殿：提爾、蘇妮與坦帕斯。提爾神殿最大，巴西歐主教就住在裡面。現在請轉過身來，」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第二頁。原版每一頁各自成一段引文，這一頁的句子在下一頁接完，但引號在本頁就收掉，譯文照同樣的斷法。Tyr 提爾、Braccio 巴西歐 依 glossary 定案；Sune、Tempus 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'YOU WILL SEE THE ENTRANCE TO THE PASSENGER DOCK AREA WE JUST DEPARTED.  FEW SHIPS DARE THE PERILOUS PASSAGE HERE, BUT THE COUNCIL IS DEVELOPING A PLAN TO OPEN UP THE SEA LANES.  PLEASE FOLLOW ME.'
entries.text: 「就會看到我們剛才離開的客運碼頭入口。敢走這條險路的船不多，不過市議會正在擬定計畫，要把航道打通。請跟我來。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第三頁，承接上一頁的句子。The City Council 依 glossary 作市議會。

entries.source: 'YOUR PARTY IS TOO LARGE TO JOIN AT THIS TIME.  RETURN WHEN IT IS SMALLER.'
entries.text: 「你們人太多了，現在不能加入。等人少一點再來。」

entries.note: 同上，原版這一版帶括號。
署名片段，原版以兩個連字號起頭。

entries.source: A DRUNKEN BRAWL BREAKS OUT. YOU ARE CAUGHT IN THE MIDDLE.
entries.text: 一場酒醉鬥毆爆發，你們正好被夾在中間。

entries.source: AN AGED PRIEST APPROACHES, POINTING AT THE MAD MAN, HE SPEAKS, 'THAT MAN URGENTLY NEEDS OUR CARE.  DROP HIM FROM YOUR PARTY OR HE WILL BRING YOU TO GRIEF.  WE WILL CARE FOR HIM.'
entries.text: 一位年長的僧侶走過來，指著那個瘋子說：「那個人急需我們照料。把他從隊伍裡放掉吧，不然他會給你們惹禍。我們會照顧他。」

entries.note: 怪物名，原版拼作 ANHKHEG（一般作 Ankheg）。
怪物名；與哥布林成對，取「大」以示體型。

entries.source: HOW MANY PLATINUM PIECES WILL YOU WAGER? (HOUSE LIMIT IS 1000)
entries.text: 要下注幾枚白金幣？（莊家上限一千）

entries.note: 遭遇敘述的方位片段，原版把句子拆成幾段拼起來。

entries.source: IT'S GREEN.  YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK.
entries.text: 是綠色，你們拿回兩倍的錢。

entries.note: 怪物名；Kobold 依 glossary 定案作小妖魔。
同上，原版這一版帶句點。
選單選項，出現 62 次，是最常見的一個。
遭遇選單，指不拿走某樣東西。

entries.source: NO ONE IS WILLING TO GAMBLE WITH SOMEONE WHO LOOKS THAT BAD.
entries.text: 沒有人願意跟看起來這麼落魄的人賭。

entries.note: 遭遇選單；說明書第四章的 PARLAY 指令。
platinum pieces 的縮寫，說明書把 platinum 列為五種幣值之一。
原版的續行提示，四種拼法各自出現，逐一對應。
同上，原版這一版句尾有句點。
同上，這一版沒有提到按鈕。
同上，這一版兩者順序相反。
市政廳的公告，依 glossary 用詞。

entries.source: PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THE WALLS, IN YOUR JOURNAL YOU NOTE
entries.text: 牆上貼著公告，你們把編號記進手札：
entries.note: 市政廳外；journal 依專案用詞作手札。

entries.source: PROCLAMATIONS LXIV, LXXVIII, CIX, AND LIX.
entries.text: 第六十四、七十八、一〇九與五十九號公告。
entries.note: 公告編號，原版以羅馬數字書寫；譯文改用中文數字以便閱讀。
遭遇選單；說明書第四章的 SEARCH 指令。

entries.source: SKULLCRUSHER SPEAKS, 'I MUST GO TO MY MASTER NOW.'
entries.text: 碎顱者開口：「我得去見我的主人了。」

entries.note: 港務長航線選項；Sokal Keep 依 glossary 作索卡爾城堡。

entries.source: THE CITY WATCH CHARGES IN. DO YOU RUN AWAY OR STAY TO CONFRONT THEM?
entries.text: 城衛隊衝了進來。你們要跑，還是留下來面對他們？

entries.source: THE CITY WATCH RESPONDS TO THE NOISE.  DO YOU STAY TO FIGHT THEM OR RUN AWAY?
entries.text: 城衛隊聞聲趕來。你們要留下來打，還是逃走？

entries.source: THE CITY WATCH STOPS YOU AND REMOVES CADORNA'S TREASURE FROM YOUR KEEPING.  THEY TELL YOU YOUR REWARD WAITS WITH THE CITY CLERK.
entries.text: 城衛隊攔下你們，把卡多納的財寶收走，並告訴你們報酬在書記官那裡等著領。
entries.note: 劇情事件；Cadorna 依 glossary 作卡多納。

entries.source: THE DOOR IS LOCKED.  DO YOU WANT TO BREAK IN?
THE HARBOR MASTER TELLS YOU BOATS LEAVE FOR THE WEST, THE EAST, SOKAL KEEP, AND THE NORTH SIDE OF THE BAY.  'ROUND TRIP PASSAGE IS 1 PLATINUM PIECE. WHAT PASSAGE CAN I SELL YOU?'
entries.text: 港務長告訴你們，有船開往西邊、東邊、索卡爾城堡與海灣北岸。「來回船票一枚白金幣。要買哪一趟？」

entries.source: THE MAD MAN SUDDENLY BEGINS TO SCREAM AND ATTACK EVERYONE WITHIN ARM'S REACH.
entries.text: 那個瘋子突然尖叫起來，見人就打。

entries.source: THE PRIESTS OF TEMPUS BID YOU WELCOME.
entries.text: 坦帕斯神殿的僧侶歡迎你們。

entries.source: THE PRIESTS OF TYR WELCOME YOU TO THE TEMPLE.
entries.text: 提爾神殿的僧侶歡迎你們入內。

entries.source: THE SHOP SELLS SILVER ITEMS. 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE OUR SELECTION?'
entries.text: 這家店賣銀器。「要看看我們的貨嗎？」

entries.source: THE SHOP SPECIALIZES IN ARMS AND ARMOR. 'CAN I SHOW YOU OUR WARES?'
entries.text: 這家店專賣武器與護甲。「要我拿貨給你們看嗎？」

entries.source: THE SHOPKEEPER GREETS YOU AND OFFERS YOU ITEMS FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?'
entries.text: 店主招呼你們，開始兜售商品。「要我拿些東西給你們看嗎？」

entries.source: THE SHOPKEEPER OFFERS JEWELRY FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?'
entries.text: 店主賣的是珠寶。「要我拿些東西給你們看嗎？」

entries.source: THE TEMPLE GUARDS INFORM YOU THAT THE BISHOP IS NOT RECEIVING VISITORS AT THIS TIME.  WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 神殿衛兵告訴你們，主教這時候不見客。你們要怎麼做？

entries.note: 怪物名。與職業 Thief（賊）分開用字，避免混淆。

entries.source: TO THE NORTH IS THE PASSENGER DOCK.

entries.note: 隊伍強度回報，見 spec 030 的 PARTYSTRENGTH。

entries.source: YOU ARE BY THE GATEWAY TO THE UNSETTLED AREAS. THE CITY WATCH EYES YOU SUSPICIOUSLY.
entries.text: 你們就在通往未開發地區的門邊。城衛隊用懷疑的眼神打量你們。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A TAVERN.  THE AIR IS FILLED WITH SMOKE AND GOSSIP.  PEOPLE ARE GAMBLING AT THE TABLES.
entries.text: 你們在一間酒館裡，空氣中滿是煙味與閒話，桌邊有人在賭錢。

entries.source: YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. THE CITY CLERK WAITS INSIDE TO AWARD COMMISSIONS.
entries.text: 你們站在市政廳外。書記官在裡面發放委託。

entries.source: YOU ARE ROUSTED BY THE CITY WATCH AND TOLD TO MOVE ALONG. WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 城衛隊把你們趕起來，要你們別逗留。你們要怎麼做？

entries.source: YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE BISHOP'S STUDY. BISHOP BRACCIO SPEAKS, 'ALLOW ME TO INTRODUCE DIRTEN, PRIEST OF ILMAR.
entries.text: 你們被帶進主教的書房。巴西歐主教說：「讓我介紹伊爾瑪的僧侶迪爾騰。
entries.note: 提爾神殿；句子在原版就沒有收尾，接下一段。

entries.source: YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE STUDY WHERE DIRTEN WAITS.  'I AM ABOUT TO JOURNEY TO THE TEMPLE, WILL YOU COME WITH ME?'
entries.text: 你們被帶進書房，迪爾騰在裡面等著。「我正要動身去那座神殿，你們願意同行嗎？」

entries.source: YOU ARE WELCOMED BY PRIESTESS JOY OF SUNE.
entries.text: 蘇妮神殿的喬伊女祭司歡迎你們。

entries.source: YOU ATTACKED THE CITY WATCH, YOU WON'T BEAT US SO EASILY!
entries.text: 你們攻擊了城衛隊，沒那麼容易打贏我們！

entries.source: YOU FEEL A LIGHT TOUCH ON YOUR PURSE.  DO YOU IGNORE IT OR GRAB THE OFFENDING HAND?
entries.text: 你們感覺錢袋被輕輕碰了一下。要不理會，還是抓住那隻手？
你們聽到酒館裡的傳言

entries.source: YOU REALIZE YOU HAVE BEEN VICTIMIZED BY A PICKPOCKET.

entries.note: 遭遇敘述的開頭片段，後面接怪物名。
